gloss: large snowflakes; wet snow falling in clumps

definitions.gloss: large snowflakes; wet snow falling in clumps
definitions.explanation: Large, fluffy snowflakes that cluster together and fall slowly, resembling peony petals. This type of snow typically occurs when the temperature is near freezing.

examples.japanese: {牡丹雪|ぼたんゆき}が{静|しず}かに{降|ふ}っている。
{窓|まど}の{外|そと}には{牡丹雪|ぼたんゆき}が{舞|ま}っていた。
examples.english: Outside the window, large snowflakes were dancing in the air.

examples.japanese: {夕方|ゆうがた}から{牡丹雪|ぼたんゆき}に{変|か}わり、あっという{間|ま}に{積|つ}もり{始|はじ}めた。
examples.english: In the evening it changed to large wet snowflakes, and before long the snow started piling up.

notes:
Named after the {牡丹|ぼたん} (peony) flower because the large, clumped snowflakes resemble peony petals. This is a poetic and evocative weather term.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {牡丹雪|ぼたんゆき}が{降|ふ}る (large snowflakes fall)
- {牡丹雪|ぼたんゆき}が{舞|ま}う (large snowflakes dance)

USAGE:
{牡丹雪|ぼたんゆき} is wet and heavy compared to {粉雪|こなゆき} (powder snow), which is dry and fine. {牡丹雪|ぼたんゆき} typically falls when temperatures are close to 0°C, so it melts quickly on the ground.
